description: This is a source file implementing React components related to authentication using the Clerk library, including provider setup, route guarding, sign-in/sign-up pages, and user controls.

methods.name: getClerkPublishableKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Clerk publishable key from environment variables, warning if missing.

methods.name: AppAuthProvider
methods.description: Wraps children components with ClerkProvider, passing in the publishable key and integrating navigation.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: Checks if the user is signed in; if not, prompts to sign in; otherwise renders children.

methods.name: SignInPage
methods.description: Components rendering a styled SignIn form with Clerk defaults.

methods.name: SignUpPage
methods.description: Components rendering a styled SignUp form with Clerk defaults.

methods.name: AuthControls
methods.description: Provides sign-in link for signed-out users or user avatar menu for signed-in users.
